mode: Offline replay of archived real-AI geometry and responses; manually authored independent calculation; no new AI reasoning
prompt: Create ten identical upright regular hexagonal prisms, 30 cm across opposite flats and 46 cm tall, in two rows of five. Centers along each row are 72 cm apart; the rows are 64 cm apart and staggered by half a pitch. Center the whole array at the origin with all bases on the ground. The rows run 31 degrees from east toward north, with X east and Z north. The row on the positive perpendicular side leads by half a pitch. Keep each prism separately editable. Keep all parts independently editable and preserve unrelated objects.
